domains.title: Domain
domains.description: Type a domain and press Start. Works on live, parked, expired and fully dead domains. For several domains, put one per line.

depth.title: How far back to dig
depth.description: Standard suits almost every domain. Quick is a fast look, Deep spends longer and costs more on domains with a large archive.
enumTitles: Deep - thorough, up to 500 archived pages

sections.title: What to include in the report
sections.description: Pick which data you want. All are selected by default. Unticking 'Saved copies of the old website' makes the run about 10x faster. Unticking 'Emails and phone numbers' alone does not speed up the run because they are extracted from the same archived pages.

enumTitles: Emails and phone numbers (from archived pages, domain records, and public code)
Who registered it and when (RDAP / WHOIS domain lookup)
Subdomains and sister brands (SSL certificate transparency logs)
Where it was hosted, plus screenshots (DNS history + urlscan.io scans)
Saved copies of the old website (Wayback Machine archived pages - slowest step)
What software the server ran (from archived page response headers)
Tracking IDs linking to the owner's other sites (from archived page HTML / JS analysis)
Where else this domain is mentioned (archive full-text search + public code + Common Crawl)

whoisHistoryApiKey.title: Whoxy API key (WHOIS history - optional)
whoisHistoryApiKey.description: Pre-GDPR WHOIS records show who registered the domain before privacy rules hid everything. Get a key at https://www.whoxy.com (costs $0.005 per lookup, no monthly fee). Leave empty to skip - all other sources still run.

securityTrailsApiKey.title: SecurityTrails API key (DNS + WHOIS history - optional, free tier: 2500/month)
securityTrailsApiKey.description: Dated DNS records (A, NS) and WHOIS history going back to 2008. Free signup at https://securitytrails.com - 2500 queries/month, no credit card. Leave empty to skip.
